title: Upper case a line
description:
Read a line and convert its letters to upper case in place.

```
Text: Hello, World 2026!
HELLO, WORLD 2026!
letters changed: 8
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Text: ", 0

        section .bss
line:   resb    128

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        mov     esi, 128
        call    read_line
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `read_line` does not add a zero at the end; store one at `line + rax` so `print_str` knows where to stop.
requirements: Read with `read_line` into a buffer in `.bss`.
Walk the bytes with a pointer; change only `a` to `z` (subtract 32).
stretch: Swap the case instead: upper to lower and lower to upper.
